interpretation.implemented_scoped: Declared library-local behavior has current executable source in observed scope. Original edge/ABI/consumer acceptance may remain; this is not full-game acceptance.
interpretation.partial_missing_logic: Some behavior already exists, but explicit business sublogic is absent. Verification gaps are separate.
interpretation.not_implemented: Declared business closure lacks implementation; related primitives are not the feature itself.

limits: Do not count primitive getters, derives or absent source-level helper names as missing business algorithms.
External country-core/engine/actual payload producer integration is listed separately, not library-local code absence.
Source presence is separated from original-equivalence verification. Unknown edge policies are verification gaps unless a distinct known behavior is demonstrably absent.
